description: Defines the CartItem class representing an item in the shopping cart for a food delivery app, including properties like item details, quantity, and customizations, along with methods for total price calculation and copying with modifications.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart with associated properties such as item details, quantity, and customizations.

methods.description: Creates a copy of CartItem with specified fields replaced.
